name: AR_TRX_DIST_LINE_BALANCES_ALL
description: The AR_TRX_DIST_LINE_BALANCES_ALL table stores receivables data abstracted from standard receipts and miscellaneous receipts that should be interfaced to budgetary control product for updating the budget details. Records with PURGE_FLAG as Y get purged after the funds status value is updated by the budgetary control process. The primary key for this table is DIST_LINE_ID.

columns.name: DIST_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the distribution line.

columns.name: DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the batch that groups receipt data for interface to Budgetary Control.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the ledger where the source receipts are accounted.

columns.name: RECEIPT_BU_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the paying business unit associated with the cash receipt.

columns.name: CASH_RECEIPT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the cash receipt.

columns.name: RECEIPT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of receipt data interfaced to Budgetary Control. Valid values are Standard and Miscellaneous.

columns.name: RECEIPT_NUMBER
columns.description: Cash receipt number of the cash receipt.

columns.name: RECEIPT_LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the paying legal entity associated with the cash receipt.

columns.name: RECEIPT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the receipt currency.

columns.name: CASH_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the account code combination for the cash associated with the receipt.

columns.name: APPLICATION_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the application against a receipt. For a standard receipt, it refers to the application reference within the AR_RECEIVABLE_APPLICATIONS_ALL table.  For a miscellaneous receipt, it refers to the distribution identifier within the AR_MISC_CASH_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL table.

columns.name: APPLY_DATE
columns.description: Date the receipt activity is recorded in Budgetary Control.

columns.name: APPLIED_PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the transaction payment schedule applied to a standard receipt.

columns.name: APPLIED_CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the customer transaction applied to a standard receipt.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the line belonging to the customer transaction applied to a standard receipt. This reference is used to identify the revenue accounts collected through a standard receipt.

columns.name: CUST_TRX_LINE_GL_DIST_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the line distribution belonging to the customer transaction applied to a standard receipt. This reference is used to identify the revenue accounts collected through a standard receipt.

columns.name: REVENUE_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the account code combination for the revenue associated with the transaction applied to a standard receipt.

columns.name: BUDGET_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount in the receipt currency updated to the budget.

columns.name: FUNDS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the budget update. Valid values are Passed, Failed, Partial, Error.

columns.name: PURGE_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates whether to purge a record.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
